Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

carry in verb

also bring in, bring into, inflict, make war on, bring upon

classical

Cic. Fam. 15.2.1: bellō in prōvinciam illātō (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Att. 9.1.3: bellum Ītaliae (Lewis & Short)
Liv. 32.24.5: scālās ad moenia (Lewis & Short)

īnferō, īnferre, intulī, illātum

verb, irregular (a compound of ferō); with in and the accusative, ad, or the dative, conjugation

carry or bring into; bring upon, inflict

Bellum īnferre with the dative is to make war on; signa īnferre, to advance to the attack (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • īnferrī mēnsam secundam jussī

    I ordered the second course to be brought inPlin. NH 9.120 (Lewis & Short)

See also bring, carry, attack, introduce.
